changelog: Scene index: Y opens cast + indexed moments; Vision scans persist per timestamp so replays skip OpenAI. Playback-scene API builds your own X-Ray metadata over time.
description: Fetches complete TMDB cast and crew for movies and series, groups people by department, and shows them in a polished accordion on Jellyfin Web item detail pages. Includes a nostalgia Break Bumper action, Library Stats, studio detail pages, and optional scene identify during playback.
name: Full Crew
overview: Full cast and crew, stats, studio pages, scene identify, and a local scene index
